fields.name: UserId
fields.description: IAM user itemId. Indexed for row-level lookup. A user may have multiple active rows here -- one per org -- UNLESS their roleSlug is nurse or branch_manager (enforced by write-time check in useOrganizationMembers).

fields.name: OrgId
fields.description: IAM organization itemId this membership applies to. Indexed for org-scoped listing.

fields.name: RoleSlug
fields.description: Role assigned within this org (patient, doctor, nurse, branch_manager, ...). The role at the project level is registered separately; this column records which role the user plays WITHIN THIS ORG so a single IAM user can be doctor in org A and patient in org B without role conflict.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: active|inactive. Append-only: a status flip writes a new row rather than editing this one (matches the SRS DC-4 append-only pattern).

fields.name: LeftAt
fields.description: When the membership ended. Append-only history; status=inactive rows should always have a LeftAt.

fields.name: InvitedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user itemId of the manager/admin/clouduser who created this membership. Empty for self-signup rows (patient only).

fields.name: Source
fields.description: signup|manager_invite|admin_invite|clouduser_invite. Audit trail for how this membership originated.
